title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
description: About Zipline Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. About You and The Role Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments. You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel. This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks. What You'll Do Design, implement, scale, and continuously improve Zipline's legal and compliance programs across Africa, with a focus on sustainable, practical operations that support rapid growth Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership Manage litigation and disputes across Zipline's African markets Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams Own compliance with U.S. government award requirements, including FARs and 2 CFR 200, and serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. government contracting officers (including at the U.S. Department of State) Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed What You'll Bring A willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar issues and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-environments Strong judgment and the confidence to make independent decisions, coupled with the discernment to escalate when appropriate Experience advising on legal and compliance matters, preferably in international or emerging-market environments The ability to break down complex legal and regulatory problems into clear priorities and practical solutions Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to advise senior stakeholders A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills Willingness to travel up to ~25% to Africa and San Francisco headquarters What Else You Need To Know Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply! Voluntary Self-Identification For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. As set forth in Zipline 's Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law. title: Director, Sales - Dedrone (Counter-UAS)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p>Location: United Kingdom<br>Role Type: Individual Contributor<br>Initial Scope: UK, with the potential to expand across the Commonwealth over time<br>Travel: Significant UK travel with some international travel as required</p> <h2><strong>Your Impact</strong></h2> <p>Axon is looking for a strategic seller to help build our Defence, National Security, Public Safety and Critical Infrastructure business in the UK.</p> <p>This is not intended to be a traditional product overlay or specialist advisory role. We are looking for someone who can build a market, create pipeline, develop strategic relationships and establish the partner ecosystem required to scale.</p> <p>The role will focus across Defence, National Security, Public Safety, Critical National Infrastructure, airports, ports, defence supply chain and other strategically important infrastructure.</p> <p>The right person will bring a combination of Defence / National Security experience, commercial sales experience and a strong understanding of how to build and leverage channels, primes, systems integrators and strategic partners.</p> <p>Initially this will be a UK-focused individual contributor role. As the business and opportunity mature, there is potential for the remit to expand more broadly across the Commonwealth.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Accomplish</strong></h2> <h3><strong>In the First 6 Months</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build a clear UK market strategy across Defence, National Security, Public Safety and Critical Infrastructure.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize the highest-value target accounts, programs and routes to market.</li> <li>Establish relationships with key Defence, government, public safety, national security and critical infrastructure stakeholders.</li> <li>Build a focused network of primes, systems integrators, resellers and strategic partners who can extend Axon’s reach.</li> <li>Develop a qualified pipeline with clear customer problems, buying paths, partners and next steps.</li> <li>Create greater awareness of Axon’s capabilities beyond individual products and position the broader ecosystem against customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>In the First 12 Months</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build a meaningful and repeatable pipeline across the segment.</li> <li>Close initial strategic opportunities and establish referenceable customers and partners.</li> <li>Establish several high-value channel relationships that create scalable access to Defence, Public Safety and Critical Infrastructure opportunities.</li> <li>Position Axon as a credible participant in major Defence, public safety, national security and critical infrastructure programs.</li> <li>Create a repeatable GTM model that can eventually be expanded into Canada, Australia, New Zealand and the broader Commonwealth.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Build the Market</strong></h3> <p>Own the commercial strategy for the UK Defence, National Security, Public Safety and Critical Infrastructure segment.</p> <p>Identify where Axon can create differentiated value across airspace awareness, drone detection, real-time operations, situational awareness and the broader Axon ecosystem.</p> <p>Develop the market rather than wait for traditional inbound opportunities or formal tenders.</p> <h3><strong>Sell Strategically</strong></h3> <p>Own a defined set of strategic accounts and opportunities.</p> <p>Develop relationships at senior levels across Defence, government, public safety, national security and critical infrastructure organizations.</p> <p>Understand complex customer problems, procurement processes, funding paths and decision structures and translate them into executable commercial strategies.</p> <p>This role should be comfortable operating through long and complex sales cycles while maintaining clear commercial accountability.</p> <h3><strong>Build the Channel</strong></h3> <p>Develop strong relationships with primes, systems integrators, resellers, consulting partners and other organizations already operating within the Defence, public safety and security ecosystem.</p> <p>Determine where Axon should lead an opportunity directly and where we are better positioned as a technology partner, subcontractor or component of a broader solution.</p> <p>Build scalable routes to market rather than trying to pursue every opportunity directly.</p> <h3><strong>Connect the Axon Ecosystem</strong></h3> <p>Look beyond a single product or capability.</p> <p>Identify opportunities where Dedrone, DFR, Fusus, real-time operations and other Axon capabilities can contribute to a broader customer outcome.</p> <p>Work closely with Product, SE, CSM and regional sales teams to bring the right capabilities into each opportunity.</p> <h3><strong>Influence Across the Organization</strong></h3> <p>Operate effectively in a matrixed global organization.</p> <p>This person will need to influence Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services and executive leadership without relying on formal authority.</p> <p>They should be comfortable identifying gaps, creating clarity and driving action across teams.</p> <h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for someone who has demonstrated success in environments similar to the one we are trying to build.</p> <p>The strongest candidates will likely have:</p> <ul> <li>Meaningful experience within Defence, National Security, Public Safety or a closely related environment.</li> <li>Commercial experience selling complex technology or solutions into Defence, government, public safety or critical infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience building and managing channel relationships, including primes, systems integrators, resellers and strategic partners.</li> <li>A strong understanding of government and Defence procurement and how large programs move from concept to funding and execution.</li> <li>Credibility with senior military, government, law enforcement, security and critical infrastructure stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience creating pipeline and opening new markets rather than simply managing an established territory.</li> <li>Strong commercial instincts and demonstrated ability to close complex opportunities.</li> <li>Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor.</li> <li>The ability to influence across functions and organizations without formal authority.</li> <li>Strong judgment, resilience and a high degree of ownership.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. About the Role At Cognition, partners are force multipliers . Partner Deployed Engineers (Partner DEs) are partner-facing (and customer-facing) technical experts who enable services partners such as Global Systems Integrators to successfully deploy, scale, and deliver value with Devin and Windsurf across their client base. In this role, you will work closely with partner solution architects, delivery leads, and engineering teams to help them build repeatable offerings and internal expertise on top of the Cognition platform. Rather than owning a single customer, you’ll amplify impact by enabling partners to support many customers at scale. This role blends deep technical work, partner enablement, and ecosystem thinking. You’ll lead technical enablement sessions, co-deliver pilots, unblock complex deployments, and help GSIs operationalize Devin/Windsurf into their delivery motions. You’ll act as Cognition’s technical representative within partner organizations. In This Role, You Will Own the technical success of GSI partners across onboarding, enablement, and scaled delivery of Devin/Windsurf Work directly with partner engineering and architecture teams to understand their delivery models, tooling, and customer use cases Enable partners to build repeatable solutions, accelerators, and reference architectures using Devin/Windsurf Lead technical trainings, workshops, and deep dives for partner teams (hands-on, not slideware) Support partner-led customer pilots and early production deployments, stepping in where complexity is highest Act as a technical escalation point for complex integrations, security reviews, CI/CD environments, and enterprise workflows Build strong, trust-based relationships with partner technical leaders in GSIs (e.g., delivery heads, principal engineers, solution architects) Capture field learnings and partner feedback to influence product roadmap, packaging, and partner readiness Proactively identify gaps in partner capability and work with internal teams to close them What We Value Partner expertise. You understand how GSIs operate, deliver projects, and measure success Ownership mindset. You take responsibility for partner outcomes, not just enablement activities Technical depth. You can reason about real systems, not just demos Leverage thinking. You prefer enabling 10 teams over doing the work for 1 Bias toward execution. title: Staff Software Engineer - Workloads
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Launchables is CoreWeave's platform for building Physical Intelligence. We bring simulation, training and evaluation tools into a common platform, allowing robotics, autonomous systems and engineering teams to focus on their applications while Launchables handles common execution and infrastructure needs.</p> <p>We turn specialist Physical AI software into capabilities that researchers and engineers can use, adapt and build upon. Our work combines strong software engineering with applied domain knowledge to make complex workloads accessible, reproducible and useful in real-world environments.</p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer, Workloads - Physical AI, you will develop engine integrations, application code, adapters, templates and developer tools that make specialist software available through Launchables. You will work directly with researchers and engineers to understand their tasks, assumptions, dependencies and expected outcomes, translating these into interfaces and configurations that preserve the capabilities they need.</p> <p>You will take ownership of how users configure, run, customise and evaluate workloads. This includes defining meaningful inputs, defaults, constraints and outputs; building command-line and API interfaces; and creating examples and documentation that help users extend existing templates or author their own. You will establish appropriate validation for packaging, execution and application outcomes, working with domain specialists to make evaluation criteria and their limitations clear.</p> <p>You will profile workloads to improve preparation time, GPU utilisation, concurrency and data movement while preserving the intended computation. You will also capture the inputs, versions, settings and execution conditions needed to reproduce runs, with logs, metrics and artefacts that help users diagnose failures, compare experiments and interpret results.</p> <p>Working alongside engineers responsible for the shared runtime and platform services, you will turn feedback from early users into better interfaces, defaults, tests and guidance. You will identify reusable patterns across integrations, shape shared platform capabilities, review designs and mentor colleagues. You will use coding agents and automation to accelerate development, applying the review, testing and domain judgement needed to ensure the resulting software behaves as intended.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong software engineering skills, demonstrated through dependable software or developer tools used by other people.</li> <li>Applied depth in at least one relevant area, such as robotics simulation, autonomous-vehicle evaluation, reinforcement learning, synthetic-data generation or engineering simulation.</li> <li>Experience making specialist or research software usable beyond its original author, including configuration, testing, documentation and diagnosis.</li> <li>Sound judgement about experimental assumptions, evaluation criteria, reproducibility and the conclusions a result supports.</li> <li>Familiarity with containerised execution and experience tracing problems across application and infrastructure boundaries.</li> <li>Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools and domains, working closely with specialists and recognising when their expertise is needed.</li> <li>Evidence of improving shared tools or engineering practices across multiple projects, with clear reasoning about what should be common and what should remain application-specific.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience developing software in Python, Go or C++.</li> <li>Familiarity with simulation and machine-learning frameworks.</li> <li>Experience profiling GPU workloads and identifying performance or resource bottlenecks.</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes or workflow orchestration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You enjoy turning specialist Physical AI software into dependable tools that other researchers and engineers can use independently.</li> <li>You care about making experiments understandable and reproducible, with clear evidence of what their results do and do not establish.</li> <li>You combine hands-on engineering with curiosity about unfamiliar domains, and enjoy helping colleagues build reusable, high-quality systems.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome relevant experience from industry, research engineering and academia. We are interested in what you have built, how others use it and the judgement you brought to making it work.</p> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role is £116,000 to £155,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. title: Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Physical AI Engineering Team</strong> at <strong>CoreWeave</strong> is building the software and infrastructure that enables demanding AI, simulation, robotics, and engineering workloads to run reliably at scale.</p> <p>As these workloads become more complex, the challenge is no longer simply providing compute. We need to make heterogeneous workloads easier to execute, observe, reproduce, and move across different systems without hiding the capabilities or semantics of the infrastructure underneath them.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>We’re seeking a <strong>Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems</strong> to help design and build this layer.</p> <p>This is a hands-on systems engineering role at the intersection of <strong>distributed systems, runtimes, workflow execution, programming language concepts, and large-scale compute infrastructure</strong>.</p> <p>You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.</p> <p>A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful — and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.</p> <p>You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Runtime Systems & Architecture</strong></li> <li>Design and build runtime components for complex AI, simulation, and engineering workloads.</li> <li>Define abstractions for workloads, execution environments, dependencies, state, capabilities, and failure.</li> <li>Design interfaces between higher-level services and systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, and OSMO.</li> <li>Establish clear boundaries around which systems own state, decisions, and side effects.</li> <li>Make architectural decisions balancing simplicity, extensibility, performance, and operational reality.</li> <li><strong>Execution Models & Contracts</strong></li> <li>Define durable contracts between workload definitions, control-plane services, and execution backends.</li> <li>Develop typed representations and schemas that allow workloads to be transformed safely across systems.</li> <li>Design compatibility and evolution mechanisms for those contracts.</li> <li>Build conformance and validation mechanisms that make guarantees executable rather than dependent on documentation.</li> <li>Reason deeply about retries, partial failure, idempotency, cancellation, dependencies, and uncertain outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Systems Engineering</strong></li> <li>Write production-quality software for critical runtime and control-plane components.</li> <li>Build adapters and integrations for heterogeneous execution environments.</li> <li>Diagnose behaviour across application, orchestration, cluster, and infrastructure boundaries.</li> <li>Improve the reliability, observability, and debuggability of distributed workload execution.</li> <li>Work closely with Go, Kubernetes, and infrastructure engineers to turn architecture into production systems.</li> <li><strong>Performance & Experimentation</strong></li> <li>Develop rigorous ways to understand workload performance across large-scale GPU infrastructure.</li> <li>Design experiments that separate real performance gains from noise, warm-up effects, scheduling behaviour, and stragglers.</li> <li>Build repeatable workload and benchmark environments.</li> <li>Use evidence from real execution to challenge assumptions and guide platform development.</li> <li><strong>Technical Leadership</strong></li> <li>Lead ambiguous systems problems where the correct architecture is not yet known.</li> <li>Reduce complex problems into smaller contracts and mechanisms that can actually be implemented.</li> <li>Challenge unnecessary abstraction and simplify designs where complexity has outgrown its value.</li> <li>Influence technical direction across teams without requiring direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and contribute to technical hiring and engineering standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience building complex systems software, distributed infrastructure, runtimes, workflow systems, or adjacent technology.</li> <li>Deep expertise in at least one of:</li> <ul> <li>Distributed systems</li> <li>Runtime systems</li> <li>Workflow or execution engines</li> <li>Programming languages, compilers, or interpreters</li> <li>Cluster scheduling and orchestration</li> <li>High-performance or systems software</li> </ul> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals and production coding ability.</li> <li>Experience designing APIs, protocols, schemas, or contracts between independently evolving systems.</li> <li>Strong understanding of distributed-system failure modes, state, authority, retries, concurrency, and side effects.</li> <li>Strong technical judgement around when abstraction helps and when it simply moves complexity elsewhere.</li> <li>Comfortable entering unfamiliar technical domains and building depth quickly.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and experience influencing architectural decisions across teams.</li> </ul> <p>Experience with some of the following would be valuable, but is not required:</p> <ul> <li>Go, Rust, C/C++, or Python.</li> <li>Kubernetes and containerised infrastructure.</li> <li>Argo, OSMO, Temporal, Ray, Kubeflow, or similar systems.</li> <li>GPU clusters or large-scale AI infrastructure.</li> <li>High-performance computing.</li> <li>Simulation, robotics, autonomous systems, or Physical AI.</li> <li>Programming language or compiler research.</li> <li>Performance engineering.</li> <li>Cloud infrastructure at scale.</li> <li>Platforms designed to be operated by autonomous software or AI agents.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match.</strong> Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Systems Thinker:</strong> You ask where authority lives, what guarantees actually exist, and what happens when systems fail.</li> <li><strong>Technically Deep:</strong> You want to understand how systems really behave, not just how they are supposed to behave.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatic:</strong> You value elegant engineering, but care more about whether it works for real workloads.</li> <li><strong>Evidence-Driven:</strong> You test assumptions and change direction when the evidence says you should.</li> <li><strong>Strong Technical Leader:</strong> You can form a view, challenge senior stakeholders, and bring others with you.</li> <li><strong>Commercially Aware:</strong> You understand that technical decisions need to improve customer outcomes, engineering velocity, reliability, or economics.</li> <li><strong>Ownership Mentality:</strong> You take responsibility for getting difficult systems into production.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast. We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth, and we’re constantly learning. title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Turn complex network faults into lasting fixes, and make new services ready for reliable operation.</p> <p>As a Senior Network Operations Engineer in Bristol, UK, you’ll keep Graphcore’s networks reliable and secure. This full-time role spans the network lifecycle, from shaping operational requirements to resolving complex incidents.</p> <p>Your improvements will reduce downtime and manual errors across new and existing services. You’ll help colleagues operate services confidently, with practical runbooks and recovery procedures ready when problems arise.</p> <p>You’ll troubleshoot routing and firewalls, improve monitoring and automate routine operations. You’ll also support upgrades and deployments through testing, controlled changes and clear handovers.</p> <p>Your scope includes AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access and SD-WAN across cloud and on-premises environments. Occasional travel to remote data centres and offices will involve installations, troubleshooting and hands-on support.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>You’ll join a supportive, multidisciplinary IT infrastructure team that works closely together and regularly shares knowledge. With new projects ahead, you’ll bring operational experience into network designs alongside architects and project teams.</p> <p>As a senior escalation point, you’ll own complex incidents through to resolution. You’ll use monitoring evidence and recurring incident trends to prioritise reliability improvements.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <p>AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) or SD-WAN experience would be particularly valuable, but is not essential.</p> <ul> <li>At least five years’ hands-on network engineering experience, focused on production support, with certification in a major networking platform.</li> <li>Strong practical knowledge of large-scale L2/L3 networks, including BGP, OSPF, switching, routing and resilience.</li> <li>Experience supporting centrally controlled Wi-Fi, such as Cisco Meraki or Aruba, and resolving connectivity and performance issues.</li> <li>Experience managing and troubleshooting centralised firewalls, including rulesets, NAT and VPNs, plus familiarity with open-source products such as pfSense.</li> <li>Hands-on use of Ansible, Python or similar tools to automate operations and manage network configurations.</li> <li>Evidence-led troubleshooting using monitoring, packet captures and logs, alongside clear communication, documentation and sound judgement during incidents.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace experience:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li><strong>Electric Vehicle Scheme:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h3>Sponsorship</h3> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p><strong>Access to controlled technology</strong></p> <p>Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>Join the Team at Graphcore</h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p>Apply to join Graphcore in Bristol and turn your network operations expertise into more reliable services.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role will sit in either our Runtime/Compute or the Developer Experience/CICD squad.<br>As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Infrastructure IT, and other platform teams to build, enhance, and support our developer platform. You will help define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and deliver medium-to-large platform projects from implementation through    production</li> <li>Build and maintain internal platform services and tooling that improve developer experience and delivery velocity</li> <li>Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs</li> <li>Drive cloud cost efficiency and optimization across our cloud and infrastructure</li> <li>Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response</li> <li>Help evolve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows</li> <li>Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations and incident response</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>5–7 years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering</li> <li>Proficiency with Python and Java. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver defined projects independently</li> <li>Clear communication and strong collaboration skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or tooling</li> <li>Exposure to regulated or high-availability environments</li> <li>Backend development experience (Java, Python, Go, or similar)</li> <li>Familiarity with observability and reliability engineering practices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. Our mission is to empower developers with reliable, scalable, and intuitive platforms that accelerate innovation and delivery. </p> <p><strong>Working Across Regions</strong></p> <p>This role operates in a globally distributed environment, working closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and the United States. Strong communication, time zone coordination, and shared ownership are essential for success.</p> <p><strong>Travel Expectations</strong></p> <p>Periodic travel to the United States is expected for offsites, planning sessions, and collaboration. Occasional travel within the UK and Ireland may also be required.</p> <p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p> <p>We believe great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. We value <strong>impact, technical leadership, and a growth mindset</strong> just as much as specific tool experience.</p> <p>Unfortunately, we do not offer sponsorship and you do need to be living in the UK or Ireland to apply.</p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Executive
description: <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The Strategic Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by helping the world’s leading hotel, restaurant and leisure groups own their guest relationships. We partner with multi-venue operators across EMEA as trusted advisors: we take a consultative approach, uncover gaps in how groups manage guest data, operations and distribution, and design solutions that reduce reliance on third-party networks and drive measurable revenue. Since SevenRooms joined DoorDash, we work alongside DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to bring merchants a connected offer across discovery, reservations, delivery and on-premise dining.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We’re hiring an experienced Strategic Account Executive to uncover, drive and close new business with enterprise hospitality groups across EMEA. You will focus on hotel groups, multi-brand restaurant groups, and other large multi-venue operators (typically 50+ locations), selling the full SevenRooms platform: CRM and guest data, marketing automation, reservations and waitlist, table and revenue management, events and experiences, online ordering, Voice AI, and group reporting. These are complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, so you will navigate matrixed organisations, build executive-level relationships and structure commercial agreements that scale across venues and regions. You will work closely with Product, Solutions, Customer Success and Onboarding to make sure every enterprise partner launches successfully and grows with us.</p> <h2>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Win new enterprise logos.</strong> Own a named-account strategy across hotel and restaurant groups with 50+ venues, building and running a pipeline through targeted outbound, partnerships, industry events and executive networks.</li> <li><strong>Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</strong> Map decision-makers across operations, marketing, IT, finance, procurement and group leadership, and build consensus around a clear business case.</li> <li><strong>Sell a platform, not a point solution.</strong> Articulate how SevenRooms unifies guest data across venues to drive direct bookings, repeat visits, higher spend per cover and lower commission costs, and tailor the story to each group’s priorities.</li> <li><strong>Run the full sales lifecycle.</strong> Take deals from first conversation through discovery, executive presentations and live demos, commercial and financial deal structuring, RFP responses, security and legal review, contract negotiation and close.</li> <li><strong>Negotiate multi-year, multi-venue agreements.</strong> Structure pricing, rollout phasing and contract terms across brands, regions and entities.</li> <li><strong>Partner cross-functionally.</strong> Work with Solutions Consulting, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Onboarding, Customer Success and DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to shape rollout plans, integrations and long-term account growth.</li> <li><strong>Be a trusted advisor.</strong> Bring market insight, benchmarks and hospitality expertise to senior operators, and champion their success well beyond signature.</li> </ul> <h2>We’re excited about you because…</h2> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years of B2B enterprise SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding quota</li> <li>You have experience selling complex, multi-faceted platforms to mid-market and enterprise customers, ideally in hospitality, hotels, restaurants, leisure or adjacent verticals</li> <li>You have deep knowledge of, or strong relationships within, the hotel and hospitality industry</li> <li>You have experience building relationships with C-level and executive stakeholders and navigating large, matrixed organisations</li> <li>You have experience structuring and negotiating complex, multi-year deals, and managing RFPs, procurement and security reviews</li> <li>You are an outstanding presenter in person and virtually, with strong business acumen and natural curiosity</li> <li>You are self-driven, organised and comfortable managing a long, multi-threaded pipeline with forecast discipline</li> <li>You are tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools; you have worked with Salesforce, RFP management tools or similar systems</li> <li>You are open to regular travel across EMEA to meet clients face-to-face</li> <li>Nice to have: fluency in a second European language, and experience selling CRM, marketing, reservations, PMS or POS technology</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.</p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive - AI Native, EMEA
description: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. The Role: We’re hiring an Account Executive to win and grow Modal’s relationships with AI-native companies: the startups and scale-ups building their products on models from day one. These teams move fast, so our sales cycle does too. Deals often move forward from the very first call, and you’ll usually be talking directly with the founder or technical leader who owns the budget. You’ll own the full cycle, from sourcing to close to expansion, and you’ll partner closely with our founders, engineering, and product teams. You’ll also help build Modal’s presence in the developer community, because in this market, the best pipeline comes from engineers who already love the product. The ideal candidate has an engineering background, has worked as a solutions architect or in a similar technical role, and has since moved into selling. You’re as comfortable debugging a cold-start issue with an ML engineer as you are negotiating terms with a CEO. What You’ll Do: Own a book of AI-native accounts and close new business quickly, often moving from first call to signed deal in weeks rather than quarters. Sell directly to founders, CTOs, and heads of ML who define the ideal customer and hold the budget from day one. Get hands-on in technical conversations: scope workloads, set up quick proofs of concept, and show customers how Modal fits into their stack. Spot expansion early and help fast-growing customers scale their inference, training, and sandbox workloads as their usage takes off. Help build and engage Modal’s developer community through events, meetups, open-source channels, and word of mouth. Bring sharp, structured customer feedback to our product and engineering teams to shape the roadmap. Help define how Modal sells to AI-native companies, including the playbooks, pricing motions, and processes we’ll scale as the team grows. Requirements: An engineering background, followed by time as a solutions architect, sales engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role, and now experience as a closing seller. Current or recent experience at an AI-native company, ideally selling infrastructure, ML/AI, or developer tools. A track record of selling directly to founders and technical leaders and closing deals quickly in a high-velocity sales cycle. Experience building or engaging a developer community, or a clear point of view on how community drives pipeline. Enough technical depth to go deep on GPUs, inference, containers, and model training with engineers, without needing a sales engineer in the room. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Comfort in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and excitement about building processes from the ground up. Ability to work in person from our office 5 days a week. Compensation: $300K • Offers Equity • OTE $300K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. The Role We are seeking a Scientific Software Engineer to build and run the systems that connect our AI platform to physical laboratories around the world. Together with the team, you will shape the software layer of our closed-loop discovery workflow: our agents propose experiments, partner labs execute them, and the results feed back into our models to guide the next set of experiments. This role sits between lab automation and production engineering. You will bring hands-on experience with scientific or lab automation, and the engineering discipline to make those integrations secure, reliable and scalable across many partners. You will be part of a small team of materials scientists, ML engineers and software engineers, working closely with each other and with our partner labs. You will help define how our AI platform connects to the physical world and shape the tools and practices that link external partner labs to our platform. You will thrive here if you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and learning from people whose expertise differs from your own. Every partner you onboard, and every integration you harden, shortens the loop between an AI-generated hypothesis and a validated material. Build APIs and data models (e.g. FastAPI, Pydantic) for bidirectional lab-to-cloud data exchange. Integrate with lab instruments, robotic platforms, LIMS/ELN systems and scheduling software, translating between disparate formats and CuspAI's data platform. Make integrations reliable at scale: idempotency, retries, queueing, monitoring and alerting across many partners and time zones. Assist with the technical onboarding of new lab partners, assessing their systems and setting up integrations quickly and repeatedly. Collaborate day to day with experimental materials scientists, optimisation experts and engineers on the team, co-designing workflows and feeding lab realities back into platform design. Deploy and run containerised services on cloud infrastructure, with testing and CI/CD as standard. Must Have Skills and Qualifications Hands-on experience with lab automation, self-driving labs or other scientific discovery workflows, e.g. instrument control, robotic platforms, or high-throughput experimentation data pipelines. Strong software engineering background, with production experience building and operating backend services. Deep fluency in Python, including typed, well-tested code and API design. Experience designing distributed systems that integrate with external parties: APIs, message queues or event-driven architectures, and data contracts. Solid understanding of security practices for externally facing systems. A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working in a small, multidisciplinary team, and can communicate clearly with experimental scientists, optimisation experts and engineers alike. Bonus Points Experimental lab experience in materials science, chemistry or chemical engineering. Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Flyte, Prefect) or active learning loops. Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and observability tooling. Security or compliance experience or handling partner IP and confidential data. Experience working across distributed teams and multiple time zones. title: Graduate Partnership Executive
description: <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Lululemon and many more use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p><strong>The Graduate Opportunity at Fospha</strong></p> <p>Joining Fospha’s graduate programme means stepping into a fast-paced environment where you’ll gain real responsibility and exposure from day one. In Partnerships, graduates work directly with some of the world’s biggest digital platforms - like TikTok, Meta, and Snapchat - playing a key role in strengthening relationships, enabling joint initiatives, and driving partner success.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Hands-on exposure to our Partnerships:</strong> Working directly with the platforms such as Tiktok, Meta and Snap, you will build commercial acumen, develop strategic communication skills, and gain a deep understanding of how the digital advertising ecosystem works.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Exposure</strong>: With support, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to make a visible impact early on, it’s the ideal launchpad for ambitious graduates looking to break into the world of ad tech and strategic partnerships.</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive Training</strong>: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Relationship Building, Market Research & Product and Financial Management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>As a <strong>Partnerships Executive</strong>, you'll join a high-impact team focused on enabling, scaling, and deepening Fospha’s relationships with the platforms that power digital marketing.</p> <p>This is a graduate-level role designed to develop future leaders. You’ll be hands-on with major ad platforms, supporting both strategic execution and day-to-day coordination. You’ll also work closely with internal teams - especially Marketing, Product and our Customer Teams - to make sure our partners have what they need to help customers grow.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supporting our partner managers in coordinating with Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap and others</li> <li>Preparing decks, talking points and training sessions to enable partner sales teams</li> <li>Tracking and reporting on partner performance and engagement</li> <li>Liaising across internal teams to keep initiatives moving and aligned</li> <li>Owning communications or enablement efforts for specific territories or smaller partners</li> <li>Researching and initiating contact with emerging or long-tail partners</li> <li>In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen Ai hub!</li> </ul> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <p>We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. You should apply if you:</p> <ul> <li>Are an excellent communicator – written, verbal, and visual</li> <li>Are highly organised and detail-oriented</li> <li>Are curious about how marketing, measurement and partnerships work</li> <li>Can handle multiple workstreams and work well under light-touch supervision</li> <li>Thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments</li> <li>Want to make a real commercial impact from day one</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with TikTok Ads, Meta, or other digital marketing tools</li> <li>Familiarity with platforms like Notion, HubSpot, Google Sheets</li> <li>Any internship or part-time experience in partnerships, sales, marketing or client-facing roles</li> <li>Like shopping and are a customer of retail brands</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values and Principles</strong></p> <p>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Seek inclusion & diversity:</strong> We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together:</strong> We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li><strong>Grow</strong>: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li><strong>Customer at the heart</strong>: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li><strong>Candour with caring:</strong> We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can offer you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & title: EMEA Account Executive - Emerging Enterprise - London
description: About CodeRabbit CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion. Role Overview We’re looking for founding members of our Emerging Enterprise Account Executive Team in EMEA — sellers who thrive in high-growth environments and can open, develop, and close complex deals in technical markets. You’ll own a list of named prospects in markets across the EMEA region, drive outbound pipeline creation, close the initial deal, and continue to nurture and grow your accounts. This role requires ownership of the entire sales cycle as well as direct revenue responsibility for achieving and exceeding our sales goals. The role requires a deep technical understanding and curiosity to serve as a trusted advisor to prospective customers. What you will do: Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, run PoVs, and close Drive outbound pipeline in named mid-enterprise accounts Deliver high-impact demos and articulate CodeRabbit’s value to both technical and business stakeholders Land and expand — grow usage and footprint across multiple teams Develop business value assessments and quantify ROI with customers Become a product expert and understand the CodeRabbit offering and ecosystem in depth Partner cross-functionally with marketing, product, and customer success to refine playbooks and GTM strategy What You’ll Bring 3+ years of full-cycle quota-carrying experience, preferably in a technical SaaS company Proven success generating outbound pipeline and closing six-figure deals in EMEA Experience selling to engineering leaders (CTOs, VPs Eng, DevOps, etc.) Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex products quickly Track record of multi-threaded deal management and value-based selling Excellent communication, organization, and ownership mindset Strong sense of ownership, self-motivation and eagerness to acquire new skills and solve new problems Bonus Points for: Fluent German language skills (written and spoken) Familiarity with AI, developer, and open source technologies Have experience in a Product Led Growth (PLG) company Our Values 🤝 Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence 🚀 Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities 💪 Persistent, Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges 🎯 Impact-Driven Creators: Crafting intuitive tools for developers 🧠 Rapid Learners and Un-learners: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world What We Offer Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact Collaborative and innovative environment Competitive salary, equity, and benefits Professional development opportunities To apply, please submit your resume. CodeRabbit is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
description: About Evervault Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital. Role Overview You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our data platform, and you’ll design and build it largely from scratch. You’ll own the platform that collects our event data, models it, and serves it to customers with roughly 15-second freshness, including building our time-series foundations. This is a senior, hands-on role: you’ll set the architecture, write most of the code and set the bar for the data team that grows around you. You’ll work closely with our VP of Engineering, Product and our leadership team. Product decides which data products to build; you own how they’re built and what the data can support. What You’ll Be Doing Designing and building real-time ingestion for three sources: events our platform already emits, new instrumentation in our product, and data our customers send us Rebuilding our event streaming layer, with the authority to choose how Modelling structured and time-series data in ClickHouse and Databricks so aggregations, trends and benchmarks are fast and cheap at scale (our current defaults, though you can make the case for change) Designing the external data contracts and APIs customers build on, including versioning, reliability and isolation of each customer’s data Defining the event contracts our product engineers instrument against Owning the platform in production: monitoring, data quality, cost and on-call for the systems you build Your First Year In your first few months you’ll assess what we have, decide the platform architecture, and scope our first data product with Product and Engineering. After that, you’ll rebuild the streaming layer and ship the first external product on the new platform, most likely aggregated analytics or direct data access for customers. Later in the year you’ll help us hire a domain expert who decides which signals and benchmarks are worth building. Machine learning is out of scope for now; it comes once we have enough clean historical data. Requirements Production experience building real-time or near-real-time ingestion with event streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis or Redpanda Deep experience with ClickHouse or a similar analytical database, including modelling time-series data for fast aggregation at volume A track record of shipping an external, multi-tenant data product or data API that customers depended on (internal reporting pipelines alone won’t cover this) Experience migrating a messy live system to a new one without downtime or data loss Senior-level engineering habits: system design, testing, and running the services you build in production Sound judgement working independently: you’ll be our most senior data voice, and we’ll rely on your technical calls A product mindset: you won’t work directly with customers, but you’ll often be the person who knows what the data can and can’t support Nice to Have Experience in payments or with sensitive, regulated data Databricks or Spark experience alongside ClickHouse Experience as an early or founding member of a data team, including hiring This Might Not Be for You If… You’re mainly an analyst, BI or data science specialist: this role builds the platform and the external products on it Your experience is mostly dashboards, internal reporting pipelines or modelling for analysis You want a hands-off architect role: you’ll write most of the code You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday Compensation, Benefits & Why Join Competitive salary Stock options with an extended exercise window Private health insurance Unlimited PTO & flexible working hours Daily lunch budget Build a company’s data platform from the first line of code, with the authority to make the big architectural calls and work directly with C-Level Interview Process Recruiter Screen Hiring Manager Interview Technical Interview System Design Interview Final with our Founder References and Offer Location This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas. Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.
